svg.aria-label: Choose the film-making method by material state: if it dissolves in a solvent, use solution casting; if it melts or softens when heated, use solvent-free hot pressing; cure a liquid precursor in place in the hole; fill very soft, sticky materials into the hole directly or by melt filling.
